description: List the parcels a county records under an owner's name (owner, as on the tax bill, usually last name first), in one county (state and county), so the person can add theirs to Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet) with add_land (parcelNumber, state, county). Returns up to 10 parcels, each with its parcel number, recorded owner, address, acres, whether it is already on Fabrica and the fabrica.land link that adds it, and whether the owner has more. Reads county records only; nothing is created or changed. Meant for the person's own land. Needs the person to be signed in.

owner.description: The owner's name as the county records it, usually last name first as on the tax bill (e.g. 'Smith John' or 'Smith Family Trust'). A person, a couple, a trust or a company.

name: find_land_by_owner
title: Find land by owner name
